d: Namaste, Mahindra just unveiled its latest Pickup truck based on the Scorpio N, called Scorpio Lifestyler. In the global market, it will be called just Lifestyler and will have engines compliant with local regulations, but in India it will see both 2.2L Diesel and 2L Petrol engines, as we see them right now on other Mahindra cars. A slight change in tuning is expected, as other drivetrain parts have changed slightly. Here is a detailed walkaround of the exteriors and some information about the interiors.
